messages:
ella: heads up — platform is planning to flip quota attribution from `X-Redwood-Account` -> route metadata this week. this will impact SDKs and the console billing view. need a quick sync on compatibility and rollout UX.

samir: can we phase it? add a new header (e.g. `X-Redwood-Route`) while keeping the account header as a fallback. :+1: this buys time for SDK rollouts.

mira: console UX thoughts: we should surface a per-route mapping page where you can assign route aliases to billing centers. show both attributions side-by-side during transition (:eyes:). need a migration button.

joel: SDK work: python/ts/go should accept a `routeHint` option and respect `REDWOOD_ROUTE_HINT` env for server-side deployments. default behavior = preserve current account header unless `routeHint` present. add telemetry event when routeHint used.

ricardo: big FYI — billing pipeline currently uses the account header for historical charts. switching attribution will cause spikes in per-route graphs unless we run a reconciliation job. we need a backfill plan and a record of mapped attributions.

platform-bot: deploy:quota-route-hint v1.2 -> staging started by @ci (link: https://ci.redwood.example/build/4321) :construction:

ella: plan proposal i'm going to draft: 1) opt-in SDK support (routeHint option + env var) 2) console mapping UI + a "preview" mode that displays both attributions for 14 days 3) a reconciliation job that backfills past events for routes we can map 4) telemetry to validate no >30% delta per-route after rollout.

samir: add a compatibility matrix for Go/Py/TS with required minimum versions, and a lint rule that warns if SDK consumer never provides a route hint in server envs.

mira: agreed on preview mode. also add a small banner in the billing dashboard explaining the migration window and impact. allow export of the mapping for auditors.

joel: example snippets i'll include in SDK PRs:
```
# python
from redwood import Redwood
client = Redwood(api_key="${REDWOOD_API_KEY}", route_hint="team:mobile,env:prod")
# header -> X-Redwood-Route: team=mobile;env=prod

// typescript
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY, routeHint: 'team=mobile;env=prod' })
```

el la: (typo) fixed: i'll include those in the PR template and the CHANGELOG note.

ricardo: one more ask — add a console metric that shows percent of traffic still attributed by account header vs route header so we can measure adoption. also wire an alert if reconciliation job fails.

ella: will do. i'll open SDK PRs and a console ticket today and tag @samir @joel for reviews. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
